claims.statement: For the equal-length-three rooted spider T_m with 2<=m<=40, every eligible rank selects all m original endpoint leaves and has a negative complete aggregate; also x(T_m)=m throughout this finite range.
claims.scope: Retained only for the 39 graphs r-a_i-b_i-c_i (1<=i<=m), checking all 222 ranks satisfying x+2<=p and 3p<2alpha+1. It gives no conclusion for m>40 or arbitrary ordinary trees.
claims.reason: retained: the copied exact forest-DP replay reproduces the sealed evidence byte for byte, and an independent output audit checks the profile and rank boundary, first descent, original endpoint/support tags, all selected summands, and all complete sums. This is a bounded computation only; it does not establish the all-m bridge or the primary aggregate.

limitations: The computation covers only 2<=m<=40 and does not establish any unbounded family statement.
The proposed all-m first-descent bridge and selector-transfer consequence remain unproved by this audit.
